rule.title: Imperator Unleashed
rule.text: In a turn in which a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY unit made an ingress move or a Charge move, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.title: Avenging Angel
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY model only. Each time the bearer’s unit ends an ingress move, select one enemy unit within 9" of it; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

enhancements.title: Orksbane
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY model only. The bearer is equipped with Orksbane.

stratagems.title: METEORIC ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY unit that charged this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.title: PURGE BY SECTORS
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.title: KNOW NO FEAR
stratagems.target: One friendly Battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
